contract: Add a pure checked entry to the existing source accounting module, preserving the unchecked oracle entry. Validate active array extents, layer indices, finite content in [0,1], positive thickness <=1e6 cm, absolute top coordinate <=1e6 cm, root depth [0,1e6] cm and final rooted length in [0,dz]. Return status and zero outputs on invalid input, otherwise invoke the unchanged source-order equation. These are bounded ingestion constraints, not new physical equations.
gates: 100000 bitwise source comparisons through both entries O0/O2; explicit bad extent/index/nonfinite/zero thickness/root fraction cases under bounds and FPE traps; existing scheduled DCS1 preservation.
non_claims: No automatic geometry derivation, production binding, accepted mass, restart or canonical admission.
